pretreatments.description: Grinding to pass through a 12 mm sieve using a shredder-chipper (Mighty Mac, Mackissic Inc., Parker Ford, PA, USA)

Ensilage: Supplemented with water to reach a total solids (TS) content of around 40%, packed into 1-gallon-size zipper bags with 1 kg of wet giant reed in each bag, vacuumed to minimize the presence of oxygen, and placed at room temperature (25 ± 3 °C).
Fungal pretreatment: C. subvermispora (ATCC 96608) was activated on 2% malt extract agar plates at 28 °C for 7 days. The fungus was then prepared as a liquid inoculum and applied to the giant reed.
Incubation at 28 ± 1 °C for 30 days without stirring.
